_about: Dated changes to real exams that a bank must follow. The /admin Questions tab lists each event as upcoming (within 60 days) or due (date passed, not marked done). Add one with every new exam whose outline, law or format is known to change, and set done to the date the bank was updated. Checked in CI by tools/check_freshness.py. Every exam is also due for a full review 365 days after its bank last changed (lib/landingDates.json).

events.what: CCNA 200-301 v2.0 replaces v1.1: five domains, new weights.
events.action: Re-weight the blueprint and drills to v2.0; retire topics v2.0 drops.

events.what: ARRT Radiography content specifications revised: 31/46/51/72, CR removed.
New NCE: 170 items, three options, six new domains, scaled 100 to 500 with 360 to pass.
events.action: Rebuild the bank to three options and the new domains; update facts and landing.
